name: How long does the energy-efficient window replacement process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the energy-efficient window replacement process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an energy-efficient window replacement project depends on the number and type of windows, as well as the complexity of the installation. For a typical home with 10-15 windows, the installation process usually takes 1 to 3 days. This timeframe covers removal of old windows, preparation of openings, installation of new units, sealing, and cleanup. Custom orders or extensive structural work can extend the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: For an average home, energy-efficient window replacement typically takes 1 to 3 days, depending on the number and type of windows.
